title: blackboxd --help initializes daemon state and attempts to bind
wanted_capability: CLI help/version probes for daemon binaries should be side-effect-light: parse flags and print help/version without opening stores, restoring workflows, starting background workers, or binding the daemon port.
missing_primitive: early help/version exit before blackboxd server initialization
fallback_used: Verified installed blackboxd by checksum instead of invoking --help, after the help probe initialized daemon state and exited with address-in-use.
evidence: stderr:startup logs followed by Address already in use (os error 98)
notes: Surfaced while running RETRO_HARNESS against the rebuild/reinstall session. This is operator-visible harness friction: a normal install verification command caused daemon initialization and tried to bind the already-running service port.
resolution_note: Fixed 2026-07-14 on beta/blackbox-v2: blackboxd now short-circuits --help/-h and --version/-V in main() before ANY side effect - no store opens, no background workers, no port bind, no tokio runtime build. Unknown flags print an error and exit 2 instead of silently booting a daemon (the typo'd-flag-starts-a-second-daemon footgun). Live-verified: --help and --version return instantly with no state mutation; --bogus exits 2.
